# Code Reviews Skill

This package provides the `SKILL.md` configuration for the Multinex Code Reviews AI Agent.

## Capabilities
- Analyzes `git diff` outputs for violations of the Multinex architecture guidelines.
- Enforces strict typing (no `any`), checks for `// TODO` placeholders, and validates security/Airlock rules.
- Outputs direct and severe code reviews highlighting the exact lines violating the constitution.

## Usage
Inject `SKILL.md` into your LLM's system prompt to activate these capabilities. The agent will require tool access to `run_shell_command` and `read_file` to execute `git diff` and inspect local modifications.
